prompt: RFC 3986 relative-part path rule instead of path-rootless
answer:
In RFC 3986, `relative-part` uses `path-noscheme`, not `path-rootless`:

```abnf
relative-ref   = relative-part [ "?" query ] [ "#" fragment ]

relative-part = "//" authority path-abempty
              / path-absolute
              / path-noscheme
              / path-empty
```

`path-rootless` is used in `hier-part` for a URI with a scheme:

```abnf
hier-part = "//" authority path-abempty
          / path-absolute
          / path-rootless
          / path-empty
```

Sources: [Pike RFC 3986](http://pike.lysator.liu.se/rfc3986.xml), [NIST URI Usage](https://pages.nist.gov/OSCAL/learn/concepts/uri-use)
